reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are the first time a supplement ad has answered my 'is it really tested' question. At $24.99 for the first box and with the empty-box refund, I would risk it on a TikTok impulse if a video hit my sleep problem.
objection: I already have a drawer of half-used bottles, and I would only believe the report is real if I could open it and see the batch number match. Even $24.99 is a lot when I am stretching my money.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR code did not open a real lab report with my batch number, or the refund looked hard to get, I would not buy.
